description: The pie chart presents the distribution of relation categories in the MMRA benchmark, showing 11 slices in total, each labeled with a count and percentage on or near the corresponding wedge. The slices are: ObservationAngle in light cyan at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in orange at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in pink/red at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in reddish-orange at 100 (9.65%); Environment in dark teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in light green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in light blue at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in very light blue at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in light gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). There is no separate legend; instead, the labels with percentages are printed directly, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the wedges appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller around the circle.
